999008199.text: はあぁ……緊張した～！
最後の質問はびっくりしちゃったね

localizations.en: That last question really caught us off guard.

999008199.text: なんとか、かわせたとは思うっす

localizations.en: I think we dodged it, though.

999008199.text: あれ、この荷物は誰の？

鏑矢さんの言ってた
素材になりそうな特産物じゃないかしら

localizations.en: These must be the specialty materials Kaburaya mentioned.

999008199.text: わーお、わおわお、もう！？　仕事が早い……

これだけ手が回るのが早いとなると
宿でも気を抜かないほうがいいかも

localizations.en: If she can get things done this quickly, we probably shouldn't let our guard down at the inn either.

999008199.text:
うん、会話を盗み聞きされてるつもりで
しゃべったほうがいいと思う

localizations.en: Yeah, we should probably talk like someone's listening in on us.

999008199.text:
こういうケイウンのことわざを聞いたことがあるよ。
「壁に耳ありジョージにメアリー」って

localizations.en: I heard a Keiun saying once: The walls have ears, and George has Mary.

999008199.text: メアリー……ジョージと幸せにね

localizations.en: Mary... I hope she and George are happy together.

999008199.text: ええと、それはちょっと違うんじゃないかしら……？

localizations.en: Um, I don't think that's how the saying goes...?

999008199.text:
それよりほら、特産物！
早速中身を見てみようよ！

localizations.en: Anyway, look at all these specialties! Let's check out what's inside!

999008199.text:
うん！　あたしも調べてみたくて
うずうずしてたとこ！

localizations.en: Yeah! I've been itching to examine them!

999008199.text: ふぅー、終わった～
んん……どうだった？
どれも面白そう！　色んなレシピに使えそうだよ

localizations.en: They all look interesting! I bet I can use them in all sorts of recipes.

999008199.text: ふうむ、このようなものが錬金術の素材になるのか

localizations.en: Fascinating. So these are the kinds of things used as alchemy materials?

999008199.text:
そうなんで……
きゃ――

お静かに。辺りに忍びがいないのは確認しましたが
叫ばれては無用に注目を集めてしまいまする

localizations.en: Please keep your voice down. I confirmed that there are no spies nearby, but if you scream, you'll draw unnecessary attention.

999008199.text:
び、びっくりしたぁ……
心臓が口から飛びでるところだった

localizations.en: Y-you scared me... My heart almost jumped out of my mouth.

999008199.text:
いつの間に……
気配、まったくなかったのに

localizations.en: When did you get here...? I didn't sense you at all.

999008199.text:
それが忍びのすごいところだよ。で、どうだった？
鏑矢とコウセンには会えたかい？

localizations.en: That's what makes ninjas so impressive. So, how did it go? Did you get to meet Kaburaya and Kosen?

999008199.text:
ふむ……やはり好戦的ではあったが
それ以外はいつもの彼女らしい新しいもの好きな性格か

localizations.en: Hmm... So she was aggressive as expected, but otherwise showed her usual curiosity.

999008199.text:
残念ながらコウセンは不在でしたが
次は会わせてくれそうな感じでした

localizations.en: Unfortunately Kosen wasn't there, but it seemed like she'd introduce us next time.

999008199.text:
コウセンはケイウン一の陰陽師、か。
妬けるぜ

localizations.en: Kosen, the finest onmyoji in all of Keiun, huh? Hurts a man's pride.

999008199.text: 俺も小さい頃から修行をしておけばよかった

localizations.en: I should have trained harder when I was little.

999008199.text: 昔はさぼってたんですか？

localizations.en: Did you slack off back then?

999008199.text:
いや、うちは武家でね。昔は武士の修行をしてたんだ。
でもそのうち陰陽師のほうが性に合ってると感じてね

localizations.en: No, my family were warriors. I used to train as a samurai. But eventually I realized onmyoji arts suited me better.

999008199.text:
それで転職したのさ。武士になるには家柄も必要だから
最初はみんなもったいないと言ってたけど……

localizations.en: So I switched careers. You need the right bloodline to become a samurai, so at first everyone said it was a waste...

999008199.text:
決まりに縛られずお前のやりたいようにやるがいい……
最初にそう背中を押してくれたのは鏑矢だった

localizations.en: 'Don't be bound by traditions—do what you want to do.' Kaburaya was the first person to encourage me like that.

999008199.text:
決まりに縛られず、やりたいように……
うん！　鏑矢さん、分かってる！

localizations.en: Not being bound by traditions and doing what you want... Yeah! Kaburaya's got that right!

999008199.text:
家も継げない次男坊だしと最終的に家族も諦めて
なんとか認めてくれてね。鏑矢さまさまだよ

localizations.en: Since I was just a second son who couldn't inherit much anyway, my family eventually gave up and accepted it. I owe it all to Kaburaya.

999008199.text:
……永遠の陰陽術は武士の体捌きが加わった
唯一無二のもの、悔いることもなかろう

localizations.en: ...Towa's onmyoji arts, combined with his samurai training, are truly unique. There's no cause for regret.

999008199.text: 確かにそうだ。回り道でも俺には必要な道だったな

localizations.en: You're right about that. Even though it wasn't smooth sailing, it all turned out to be necessary.

999008199.text:
自分の気持ちに素直なところは
鏑矢さんと気が合いそうかも……

localizations.en: Be honest with yourself. You and Kaburaya might be cut from the same cloth...
